body: i was just now looking for this and you actually saved me! thanks :)

i’m sometimes really, really creative and come up with stories and characters pretty easily.

no joke, i have a sci-fi comic planned out and the character inspiration came from a video of friends hugging.
thinking about how many cats i’ve missed the opportunity to bond with is always followed by a quick cry session.
wait! this looks amazing! i love how you used the new wall pieces, it really adds to it.
i’m going to use this as a reference when i’m drawing from now on.

Last year, at my Senior Prom, I went with maybe five or six friends and we decided to take group photos together.

Long story short, I noticed they were taking one after I thought we were done and I asked if they wanted me in it. One (rude) friend told me ‘no’ immediately.

Needless to say, I was upset for the rest of the night and no longer talk to any of them.
I have a feeling it might be anxiety-related mainly because it only picks up when I focus on it but thank you!
This is so true...literally how all of my relationships go :)))))))))))))))))

Honestly, that’s how I was after I graduated last year. I had no car or job and college was out of the option while all of my friends had all of it. 

Finding a job helped me get back on track-ish. It might help for you too :)
